clock_constants.BAUDOUT_relation: BAUDOUT = XIN / divisor where divisor = (DLM << 8) | DLL; 1 ≤ divisor ≤ 65535
clock_constants.Max_baud_rate: 1.5 Mbaud (typical) at high XIN; DC at high divisor

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.modulation: GFSK with BT=0.5; modulation index 0.45..0.55 (Standard); 0.495..0.505 (Stable Modulation Index)
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.whitening_polynomial: x^7 + x^4 + 1 (7-bit LFSR seeded with channel index || 1, LSB position 6 first)
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.encryption: AES-128 CCM with per-direction 39-bit packet counter + 4-octet MIC
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.ecdh_curve: NIST P-256 for LE Secure Connections

crc_polynomials.CRC5_covers: Token packet ADDR + ENDP fields OR SOF FRAMENUM field
crc_polynomials.CRC24_covers: PDU header + payload (excluding Preamble + Access Address)
crc_polynomials.CRC24_initial_value_data: Per-connection negotiated value (derived from CONNECT_IND CRCInit field)
crc_polynomials.CRC24_LSB_first: Yes — bits sent LSB first; polynomial reversed in implementation

LE_1M.use_case: BLE 4.x default; mandatory for any 5.x device

default_signal_state_when_idle.HS_idle: Squelched (transmitter off); receivers in low-power state
default_signal_state_when_idle.radio_off: Radio fully powered down to save energy.
default_signal_state_when_idle.advertising_off: No transmissions; baseband may be clock-gated.

channel_frequency_table_summary.note: Data channel indices 0..10 map to 2404..2424 MHz (skipping 2402 which is adv-37); 11..36 map to 2428..2478 MHz (skipping 2426 which is adv-38). Primary advertising 37=2402, 38=2426, 39=2480 MHz.
